_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 11% breaker base rate makes HOLD the skilled call; fear/greed ~53 and flat BTC support a one-rung drift into Complacency unless flows or impulse force a exit.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase but inflow color is cautionary, not directional long
next_move.confirmed_if: fear/greed holds 47-54, BTC rangebound, ETF flows stay near floor
next_move.invalidated_if: fear/greed leaves 39-62 on a sharp BTC impulse or ETF flows rebound hard enough to force a rung change
